title: Concrete Textual control-center application and canonical live-state remediation

merge_window_decision.reason: R02 owns the concrete devtool tui application/runtime projection boundary; R01 owns execution presentation and R03 owns shortcut/CLI parity plus broad qualification.

promises.text: Interactive devtool tui is a concrete Textual widget tree, not Header + one Static + Footer.
Dashboard, Runs, Logs, Diagnostics, History, Targets, Workers, Validation, Artifacts, Overlays and Evidence are concrete ContentSwitcher pages with real widgets.
RunList/ReferenceTable concepts are concrete DataTable widgets, NodeTree is a real Tree, logs use bounded RichLog, and confirmation/help use real modal screens.

The production provider projects existing IPC/execution store, RUN catalog, validation session, artifact history, SSH provider evidence, logstore and evidence roots; it declares owns_truth=false and creates no TUI-specific durable truth store.
The app performs timer-driven live refresh without requiring a keypress and preserves selected run/node/item frontend state across refreshes.

Runs and nodes are actually selectable and selection drives node trees, detail panes, log context and action availability; diagnostics/history/targets/workers/validation/artifact/overlay/evidence tables retain item selection for details.

Cancel/retry/rerun/resume requests leave the frontend through the existing IPC broker; validation pause/stop uses durable validation control requests; transaction rollback/recovery delegates to canonical transaction authorities.

Consequential cancel, validation stop, rollback and recovery actions use real Textual confirmation modals from visible controls rather than model booleans or debug dictionaries; keyboard shortcut normalization remains R03-owned.

The Logs page displays bounded live log contents with run/node context, follow/pause control, filter input and existing clipboard integration instead of a line count; log reads remain byte- and line-bounded.
The Diagnostics page displays severity, summary and canonical detail fields including failure reason/location/remediation/evidence/source/run/node/log where available.
Prototype last_control_result/debug echo rendering is removed from the concrete runtime; page navigation switches actual visible containers rather than rewriting one Static.

Interactive layout consumes Textual terminal size/resize events, drops the navigation rail in narrow layouts, keeps ContentSwitcher bounded above the global action/status region, and exposes the action controls through a horizontally scrollable strip rather than allowing them to fall outside the viewport.

A real Textual App.run_test/Pilot integration test covers startup, navigation, visible page changes, focus transfer, run selection, node tree, log follow/pause/filter, diagnostics, destructive confirmation through the visible action control, narrow-Termux action-strip reachability, action dispatch, help and live provider transitions; native workflow requires Textual.
Renderer-independent --once remains import-safe/read-only while now embedding a canonical provider snapshot instead of claiming the empty model is live runtime truth.
